qualification: Bobovka Lipno is one dedicated two-track visitor destination in Slupečná, with an Alpine Coaster rail track and an older trough toboggan track; one standalone identity follows the already integrated Bobovka Prosek precedent. The hidden legacy Park and its sole ParkItem were retired during controlled migration, avoiding a second public destination.
sourceLimitations: Official operator website redirected from bobovkalipno.cz and returned HTTP 503 during research on 2026-11-14; current ticket prices and precise hours were therefore left unset.

Both available exact licensed photographs show the older trough track in August 2014, before the newer rail coaster. Captions explicitly state their date; a current exact rail-track photo remains desirable.
Length and Wiegand model describe the rail coaster specifically; the trough track has separate dimensions.
